summary: American Water Capital Corp., the finance subsidiary of American Water Works Company, Inc., filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of senior notes maturing October 1, 20XX, with semi-annual interest payable April 1 and October 1 beginning April 1, 2027. The notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with existing senior debt, and benefit from a parent support agreement but no subsidiary guarantees. Joint book-running managers are PNC Capital Markets, Mizuho, RBC Capital Markets, and US Bancorp. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; pricing terms and use of proceeds remain blank in the preliminary filing.
